case_overview: Customer Ananya Sharma reported being overcharged INR 2,499 for a subscription service after downgrading her plan to INR 1,499 prior to the billing date. She shared a screenshot of her invoice as supporting evidence and contacted support for resolution.
key_issue: Customer was overcharged INR 1,000 despite a plan downgrade before the billing cycle.
action_taken: The billing team investigated the issue, confirmed the overcharge, and processed a refund of INR 1,000 to the customer. The customer was informed that the refund will take 5-7 business days.
recommended_next_action: Monitor the refund to ensure it is processed within the promised timeframe and send a confirmation email to the customer once the refund is completed.

case_overview: Rahul Mehta reported a delay in the delivery of his order, which was scheduled for 10 August but remains undelivered. The tracking has shown 'In Transit' for four days without update. Escalation to the logistics team was necessary as the issue has exceeded the expected delivery date.
key_issue: Order not delivered by expected date and tracking status unchanged.
action_taken: Customer support contacted logistics, raised a delivery investigation, and informed the customer of an expected update within 48 hours.
recommended_next_action: Follow up with the logistics team if no update is received within 48 hours and proactively inform the customer of any new developments.

case_overview: Priya Nair reported a recurring issue with the mobile application, which crashes immediately after she enters her login credentials. Despite attempting basic troubleshooting like restarting her phone and reinstalling the app, the problem persists.
key_issue: Mobile application crashes post-login, unresolved by standard troubleshooting.
action_taken: The support agent guided the customer through additional troubleshooting steps, collected necessary device and app version details, and escalated the case to the technical team for in-depth investigation.
recommended_next_action: Monitor the technical team's analysis and follow up with Priya Nair as soon as an update or fix is available. Ensure continued communication and provide interim updates to the customer.

case_overview: Vikram Rao reported being unable to access his account after changing his phone number, as the password reset link was sent to his old number.
key_issue: Password reset link was being sent to the customer's old, unregistered phone number, blocking account access.
action_taken: Support team verified the customer's identity, updated the registered phone number, and guided the customer to reset the password, successfully restoring account access.
recommended_next_action: No further action required. Monitor for any similar system-triggered issues and ensure customer contact details are routinely updated.

case_overview: Sneha Iyer reported dissatisfaction due to a delayed service appointment; the technician arrived two days later than scheduled, forcing her to rearrange other commitments. She has requested a formal review of the service experience.
key_issue: Technician arrived two days late for scheduled service appointment, causing inconvenience.
action_taken: The service team apologized, recorded the complaint, and initiated a service-quality review. No compensation or final resolution has been offered so far.
recommended_next_action: Proceed with a formal review by the service-quality manager, communicate findings and potential corrective actions to the customer, and consider offering appropriate compensation for the inconvenience caused.
